extra.label_text: This code was written by Claude.
issues: Does not calculate or filter daytime temperatures; it plots every row in the input DataFrame.
Does not aggregate to daily temperatures despite the requested title indicating daily temperatures.
Silently ignores timezone conversion/localization errors, which can hide malformed datetime data instead of raising ValueError.
Does not validate that the temperature values are numeric.
Mutates global matplotlib rcParams, which can affect unrelated plots created later.

bcb_grade.detail: ValueError: DataFrame contains no daytime temperature values.
